title: Summon Next Turn
description: At the start of your next turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]2[/blue].
smart_description: At the start of your next turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
notes: This power activates at the start of the player's next turn, immediately summoning creatures and then removing itself. The Amount field determines how many creatures are summoned.
